subject: Texas AI Docket — Carousel No. 1 — August 16th, 2026 — Terafab, Grimes County
body:
Terafab, Grimes County

Carousel No. 1, August 16th, 2026

Shipped at 7.0

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it Terafab, Grimes County, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

One roof, 1.89 miles on a side.

SpaceX would stack logic, memory and advanced packaging under it in Grimes County. The Governor's office announced it on August 6th. The stated first phase is "more than $16.8 billion" and "3,000 new jobs".

On August 3rd the same office told the utility commission and ERCOT to audit every data center in an interconnection queue holding "approximately 474 gigawatts of requests". The easy reading is that one company got waved past the pause. The record does not support it. KBTX reported on August 5th that a Terafab representative said the plant will build its own gas-fired power plants, which is a different thing from an exemption.

The deck puts the roof at true scale on Grimes County and this plant outside the frozen queue. No acreage and no site plan are published.

Who reviews a plant that asks the grid for nothing?

#GrimesCounty #ERCOT #Terafab
